title: AI Gateway Anthropic Messages passthrough on Amazon Bedrock: build a new Bedrock body and URL instead of mutating the request payload
answers: Why does /gateway/anthropic/v1/messages return 501 for Claude models on a Bedrock endpoint?
Why does a Bedrock fallback leg receive a body without model or stream fields, and how is the caller's payload kept intact?
Where is the Anthropic Messages passthrough for Bedrock API key endpoints handled?
Why does a Bedrock Claude request with an inference profile ARN build a valid invoke path?
body:
Path: Anthropic Messages requests (thinking, output_config, tool use and other native fields) routed to an AWS Bedrock endpoint go through AmazonBedrockProvider._passthrough in mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py, which posts the native body to model/{model}/invoke, or model/{model}/invoke-with-response-stream when the body sets stream.
Rule: Build the Bedrock body as a new dict that drops model and stream and adds anthropic_version bedrock-2023-05-31. Never edit the caller's payload, because FallbackProvider hands the same payload to the next provider. URL-escape the model name with quote(safe=":") so inference profile ARNs, which contain "/", form a valid path.
Symptom: Before this passthrough existed, AmazonBedrockProvider had no PASSTHROUGH_PROVIDER_PATHS entry, so the route fell through to BaseProvider._passthrough and returned 501 for Bedrock Claude models. Provider-native parameters such as thinking were unreachable, and an endpoint with a Bedrock fallback leg returned 501 on failover.
Constraints: Applies only when the endpoint's model is Anthropic; other models get a 400. Applies only to Bedrock bearer-token (API key) auth; SigV4 modes (access keys, IAM role, default chain) get 501. Client auth headers are always dropped, including a credential agent's own key, because Bedrock only accepts the endpoint's API key. The anthropic-beta header is not translated into the body.
applies: AmazonBedrockProvider passthrough for the Anthropic Messages route in the AI Gateway; does not cover Boto3 invoke_model for SigV4 auth modes.

search: AI Gateway Anthropic Messages passthrough on Bedrock API-key endpoints: builds a new Bedrock body without model or stream and adds the bedrock anthropic_version, leaving the caller's payload unchanged, and URL-escapes the model name so inference profile ARNs form a valid path. Applies only to Anthropic models with bearer-token auth; SigV4 modes return 501 and non-Anthropic models get 400.
